en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town in a wide alpine valley, with large mountains rising steeply behind it. The town consists of clustered low-rise buildings with light façades and tiled roofs, fields in the foreground, and a prominent church tower near the center-right. In the upper-right corner of the image the caption reads "Pinzolo - Panorama".
